Company Overview

Built by one family, four decades ago.

Founding Generation · 1983

(Late) Ramesh Kumar Gupta & Usha Gupta

Founders, Rose Laboratories

Rose Laboratories began in 1983 in Bihar, when Ramesh Kumar Gupta and Usha Gupta set out to manufacture classical and proprietary Ayurvedic formulations with consistency and care — at a time when few small units in the region attempted that level of discipline. What started as a modest manufacturing setup grew, year by year, into a unit trusted by retailers, physicians, and institutional partners across the region: a single product line became dozens, a small workspace became a certified manufacturing facility, and a family endeavour became a multi-decade success story. Their insistence that traditional Ayurveda deserved the same rigor as modern pharmaceutical manufacturing is the principle Rose Laboratories is still run on today. Though they are no longer with us, the unit they built — and the values they built it on — continue through the family and team that now carry it forward.

Vision & Mission

What we're working toward, and why.

Our Vision

To be India's most trusted Ayurvedic pharmaceutical manufacturer — a company where classical wisdom and modern quality science coexist without compromise, making safe, effective, and accessible Ayurvedic healthcare available to every household and healthcare institution across the country.

Our Mission

To manufacture classical and proprietary Ayurvedic formulations of the highest quality under WHO-GMP compliant, ZED-certified processes — delivering measurable therapeutic value to patients, credible products to healthcare professionals, and reliable supply to our distribution partners.

Corporate Values

Standardized Wisdom. Disciplined Science.

Six commitments that have guided every formulation, every batch, and every partnership since 1983.

Classical Fidelity

Our Churna, Bhasma, Arishta and medicated oil formulations are prepared true to classical Ayurvedic pharmacopoeia — batch after batch, without deviation.

Disciplined Quality

WHO-GMP compliant processes, ISO 9001:2015 certification and ZED-certified sustainable practices govern every stage — from raw material to finished pack.

Four Decades of Trust

From a single-unit beginning in 1983 to 93 formulations serving retail, OTC, and institutional channels — built on sustained performance, not quarterly promises.

Research Integrity

Every formulation is evidence-informed and pharmacopoeia-aligned. Classical indications are respected; modern quality controls ensure predictable, safe outcomes.

Partner Commitment

We work with distributors, stockists, healthcare institutions and medical representatives as long-term partners — not transactional supply relationships.

Responsible Growth

ZED Bronze certified sustainable operations. Growth measured not only in revenue but in regulatory trust, product breadth, and the health outcomes we enable.

Manufacturing Philosophy

Where we manufacture, and how.

"Standardized Wisdom. Disciplined Science."

Our manufacturing unit operates out of the Fatuha Industrial Area in Patna, Bihar, under the NIC classification for manufacture of pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical and botanical products. The facility is ZED Bronze certified under the MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme and follows WHO-GMP compliant manufacturing practices across our proprietary and classical product lines.

Company Timeline

Four decades of formulation discipline.

1983

Founded by Ramesh Kumar Gupta & Usha Gupta

Rose Laboratories was established as a small Ayurvedic manufacturing unit in Fatuha, Patna — built on classical pharmacopoeia, family discipline, and the conviction that traditional medicine deserved the same rigour as modern pharmaceuticals.

2000s

Portfolio Expansion

Systematic expansion of the product range into proprietary therapeutics, classical preparations, and external-use formulations — growing from single-category to four distinct therapeutic lines.

2010s

Institutional Partnerships

Products introduced to institutional channels across Bihar and neighbouring states. OTC and B2B distribution networks established across pharmacy chains, hospitals and healthcare clinics.

2023

ZED Bronze Certified

Awarded ZED Bronze certification under the MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme — Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises. Registration: UDYAM-BR-26-0000468.

2026

ISO 9001:2015 & WHO-GMP Certified

Rose Laboratories achieved independent certification under ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (Cert. No. ACC/26/ISO/665) and WHO-GMP Good Manufacturing Practices (Cert. No. WGMP-26061913) — both valid through 2029. A defining milestone in the company's quality journey.

Today

Led by Alok Kumar Gupta, Managing Director

Now under the stewardship of Managing Director Alok Kumar Gupta, with Ankur Gupta as Strategic Advisor, Rose Laboratories operates 93 formulations across proprietary and classical lines — WHO-GMP compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified, and expanding into new markets and digital channels.
